================================================================================
Long keyword followed by a separate word
================================================================================
value.othermatch box
---
(program (word) (long_statement (word)))

================================================================================
Short retained keyword followed by its delimiter
================================================================================
value.other(box)
---
(program (word) (short_statement (word)))

================================================================================
Retained short prefix cannot bypass a pending longer keyword boundary
:error
================================================================================
value.othermatchbox
---
(ERROR (word) (word))

================================================================================
Retained prefix still requires its delimiter
:error
================================================================================
value.otherbox
---
(ERROR (word) (word))

================================================================================
Whitespace before an immediate retained prefix is rejected
:error
================================================================================
value. other(box)
---
(ERROR (word) (word))
